Hey Hansma,

I agree with you 100%!

I am labeling and listing everything I "see" to create a list of parameters which I will test to determine their importance to the overall setup. My goal is to narrow the parameters down to be as simple as possible. Ideally, as you mentioned, I would like to be able to identify two or three patterns within the appropriate scale.

For example: If I find an IQM on a higher time frame and drop down to a lower scale chart to draw the kink (the FTR where price made the decision to ignore the level)....the best reactions occur when there is a tiny IQM located on the low time frame of the kink itself...basically an IQM within an IQM.

Still training my eyes to only see what is important

It would be interesting to add a journal/topic/group on RTM where members post a personalized custom business trading plan and open a live account where they record every trade for the community to see. Whether it is managed through some kind of online journal (like fxbook) or manually listing the result of every trade, it would be really fun and informative.

I came up with this idea while trying to come up with a strategy for improving my discipline. Too much trading on a demo account isn't good....at some point going live is a necessity. Trading psychology is a HUGE part of success in this business and I can't work on my trading psych until real money is on the line. Doesn't have to be a huge account...just knowing real money is at stake is good enough for me. Posting everything on RTM will make everything transparent and it will force me to record all of my trades... both winning trades and losing trades.

Anyone else think this is a good idea? Should I just open a new topic or is this something that needs to be approved by the admins of the site

Maybe I'll be the first one to get a live journal started...

Lately, I have been focusing a majority of my time on IQM's and ignored levels. I especially like when a big momentum bars engulf these ignored levels because the FTR/kink is hidden.

I still have a hard time identifying the right IQM/ignored level. Every IQM has an LS, and there are many LS on the chart in every scale. Not all LS are created equal, and not all LS can be expected to bounce price. Sometimes they work like magic, and other times they are completely worthless. I must find a way to filter out weak LS and IQM's in favor of stronger ones that will bounce price and provide strong RR.

How do we go about 'rating' these levels?
